lessons.claim: ★ That G'(omega) cannot be extracted from a single trapped chain is not a circumstance of the measurement but a theorem -- a bulk stress is by definition (a) a volume average containing statistically many particles and (b) Batchelor's formula presupposes that the particles are force- and torque-free. A trap is an external force so it breaks (b) (an external torque even creates an antisymmetric stress), and a single chain breaks (a). The K' and K'' we measure are stiffnesses and not stresses, and renaming them G makes them wrong. For a real G' you have to impose shear with periodic boundaries + a network of chains + no traps and compute the stress with Kramers/virial
